name: RAD51 paralog B
pathways: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: RAD51B encodes DNA repair protein RAD51 homolog 2. Annotated molecular activities include ATP-dependent DNA damage sensor activity and ATP-dependent activity, acting on DNA. It participates in DNA repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.
